note: The 2025 FBS season, computed (scripts/sync-cfb-seasons.mjs; docs/design/college-football.md, "Earlier seasons"): each school's squad as [name, position, years in college, recruiting grade or null, value, rank at the position, rating before the move, rating]; its conference, record and points against FBS schools, its Simple Rating System and its move; and the season's games between FBS schools as [home, away, home points, away points, neutral, postseason].

conversion.overall: Computed: each player's value is a weighted sum of standardised signals of his position (their share of their school's passes, carries and catches, their yards, the tackles, sacks and passes defended their plays name, their interceptions and field goals, his 247Sports recruiting grade and his years in college), pooled over 2025 and the two seasons before it 3:2:1; the weights were fitted to College Football 27's launch ratings of the players of 2025 who returned in 2026 and frozen. Each school's best at each position (College Football 27's depth) are ranked across the season's FBS schools and read off College Football 27's ratings at that position (Week 10 Ratings). Each school then moves toward its results: its Simple Rating System over the season's games between FBS schools (reliability 0.913), times √reliability ÷ 4.093 points a game per point of played strength, about the schools' mean 80.27; every player of the school by a whole number and its best few one more, never reordered.
